:::

::: {.ref-description}
- `experiment.xenium`: File containing specifications.
  - `nucleus_boundaries.parquet`: Polygons of nucleus boundaries.
  - `cell_boundaries.parquet`: Polygons of cell boundaries.
  - `transcripts.parquet`: File containing transcripts.
  - `cell_feature_matrix.h5`: File containing cell feature matrix.
  - `cells.parquet`: File containing cell metadata.
  - `morphology_mip.ome.tif`: File containing morphology mip.
  - `morphology_focus.ome.tif`: File containing morphology focus.
:::

## Example commands

You can run the pipeline using `nextflow run`.

### View help

You can use `--help` as a parameter to get an overview of the possible parameters.

```bash
nextflow run openpipelines-bio/openpipeline_spatial \
  -r v0.5.0 -latest \
  -main-script target/nextflow/convert/from_xenium_to_spatialdata/main.nf \
  --help
```

### Run command

::: {.callout-note appearance="simple" title="Create a params.yaml"}
The command below reads this component's arguments from a `params.yaml` file. To create one:

- generate it with the form on [Viash Hub](https://www.viash-hub.com/packages/openpipeline_spatial/v0.5.0/components/convert/from_xenium_to_spatialdata);
- see examples of using params files in the [guides](/guides/index.qmd);
- run several samples in one go with a [`param_list`](/guides/process-many-samples.qmd).
:::

Run locally with:

```bash
nextflow run openpipelines-bio/openpipeline_spatial \
  -r v0.5.0 -latest \
  -profile docker \
  -main-script target/nextflow/convert/from_xenium_to_spatialdata/main.nf \
  -params-file params.yaml
```

::: {.callout-note appearance="simple" title="Other backends and platforms"}
Replace `-profile docker` with `-profile podman` or `-profile singularity` depending on the desired backend. To run on Seqera Platform or through Viash Hub, see the [guides](/guides/index.qmd).
:::
